independence_evidence: The about page calls THIIIRD an independent magazine and inclusive platform; the site footer and privacy policy identify the publisher as THIIIRD MEDIA CIC, a community interest company at Cell Studios, Arcola Street, London E8.
qualifies_reason: Independent London community-interest-company publisher whose Issue #7 (Dis/comfort) was released in print in June 2025 and remains on sale in its own shop.
what_it_is: A London print magazine of fashion editorials, feature interviews, photo stories and essays centred on people of colour, queer, trans and non-binary creatives and others from underrepresented backgrounds. Each themed issue (the latest is Dis/comfort) appears with several covers and sits alongside a podcast and events programme. It is for readers interested in fashion, arts and culture framed through intersectional and decolonial perspectives.

uncertainties: No frequency is stated; the shop shows Issue #6 (Body Movements) listed May 2022 and Issue #7 (Dis/comfort) listed 5 June 2025, so irregular is recorded and the issue date is the shop listing date. Identity tags: the about page says the platform centres people of colour and queer, trans and non-binary people and that its ethos is informed by decolonial and intersectional feminist thought, but it does not state in so many words who leads the organisation, so 'queer-led' is an inference from the stated mission and 'decolonial' from the stated ethos; 'black-led' and 'women-led' are not claimed on the site even though the editor-in-chief is a Black woman. Trim size and page count are not stated.
